description: Texture hunt game GA49 for Rokid glasses: five target textures (wood grain, metal, fabric, glass, paper). Get close to a real surface so it fills the frame and snap; the host LLM judges the surface texture itself - not the object name - and answers VERDICT YES/NO with a reason. Swipe switches unattempted rounds, nod logs a non-scoring appeal. Camera only.
name: texture-hunt
